stem: 合规官正在编制管理报告信息，以便为领导层提供有关机构客户群体所涉金融犯罪风险的见解。以下哪两项是应纳入报告的关键风险指标，以便领导层能够监测客户群体固有风险是否出现任何重大变化？(选择两项。)

options.A: 针对高风险客户的监管报告中，未在规定监管期限内完成的报告占比
options.B: 与上一季度相比，升级供调查的交易监控警报数量的百分比变化
options.C: 未能在KYC政策服务级别协议(SLA)要求的时间内完成开户验证的客户所占百分比
options.D: 过去一个季度新纳入的高级政治公众人物（PEP）数量及占比，与所有活跃客户数量相比

stem_en: A compliance officer is developing management reporting information to provide leadership with insights into the financial crime risk related to an institution's customer population. Which of the following is a key risk indicator to include in the reporting to allow leadership to monitor whether there are any key changes to the inherent risk of the customer population? (Choose two.)

options_en.A: Percentage of regulatory reports for high-risk customers not completed within the required regulatory deadlines
options_en.B: Percentage change of transaction monitoring alerts escalated for investigation compared to the previous quarter
options_en.C: Percentage of customers for whom onboarding verification was not completed within KYC policy service-level agreement (SLA) requirements
options_en.D: Number and percentage of newly onboarded senior politically exposed persons (PEPs) in the past quarter compared to all active customers
